items.a: No. SaveAMedia strictly complies with creator privacy and copyright standards. Only publicly accessible Instagram Reels, videos, posts, and stories can be parsed. Content from private accounts is protected by Instagram session tokens.

items.q: Why is my downloaded Reel missing sound or audio?
items.a: Ensure your device volume or media player is not muted. If the audio is still silent, the creator may have used a licensed commercial music track that Instagram mutes when viewed outside its official app in specific countries. For original creator audio, SaveAMedia delivers the complete audio track.

items.q: Why did my Instagram Reel link fail or show 'Media Unavailable'?
items.a: Extraction failures usually happen if: (1) The account is set to private; (2) The Reel was deleted or archived by the author; (3) The link copied was incomplete; or (4) Instagram public servers are momentarily rate-limiting requests. Test opening the link in a private/incognito tab to ensure it is publicly visible, then retry.
